player_prompt.intro:
O Player {player_id} o tshameka papadi ya Dikgati e le {color}.
Dira tsamaiso ya gago ka tsela ya notation ya chess [fileRank fileRank], ka sekao '[b2c3]' (setlhare sa kolone a–h, nambari ya moralo 0–7).
Melao ya tlhago:
  • Samaile ka diagonal go ya pele ka 1 fa e le ose.
  • Gapele ka go tlhaba kgati ya mmamogedi.
  • Kgati e fiwa bogosi fa e goroga kwa bophirima.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Gaabo kgonego ya lekgetho e e nang le tsela e siameng. Tsaya [a1b2], e.g. [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Bohibidu ga bo na sepe se ba ka kgonang go se dira. Bantsho ba a fenya!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Ba ba ntsho ga ba na sepe se sengwe gape. Bohibidu bo a fenya!
outcome.no_moves: Motshameki {player_id} ga a salelwa ke motsamao ope.
outcome.draw: Tekanyetso ya go retologa e fitlhetswe.
